# Messaging Model

## Purpose
The Messaging Model defines entities for communication between users, including chats, messages, and receiver devices for notifications.

## Key Entities
- **Chat**: A conversation between multiple users.
- **Message**: A specific message within a chat.
- **ChatUser**: A user participating in a chat.
- **MessageReceiverDevice**: A device that can receive messages/notifications.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Chat
    Baseclass <|-- Message
    Baseclass <|-- ChatUser
    Baseclass <|-- ChatToChatUser
    Baseclass <|-- MessageReceiverDevice

    Chat "1" *-- "many" Message
    Chat "1" *-- "many" ChatToChatUser
    ChatToChatUser "many" -- "1" ChatUser
    Message "many" -- "1" ChatUser : sender
    Message "many" -- "1" Chat
    ChatUser "1" -- "many" MessageReceiverDevice

    class Chat {
        +String name
    }
    class Message {
        +String text
        +OffsetDateTime sentDate
    }
    class ChatUser {
        +Baseclass user
    }
    class MessageReceiverDevice {
        +String externalId
    }
```
